title: A Witness for the Will
author: Bram Montrose
blurb: Sable Eriksen, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
